title: trio_matches_row no-op detection compares name on the snapshot basis but email/phone on the effective basis — the successor idempotency test is internally inconsistent and contradicts its own doc comment
detail: ListReferenceCallsForApplicationRow selects corrected_email/phone but not corrected_name, so name compares against the immutable snapshot while email/phone compare effective (corrected ?? snapshot). A corrected successor 409s on a history-row re-submit with the corrected name yet 200-no-ops with the corrected email — mixed semantics.
recommended_fix: Add COALESCE(corrected_name,'') to list_reference_calls_for_application.sql and compare all three fields on one basis (effective), matching trio_matches and the prefill the landlord sees.
